basis: ALDH7A1 metabolic defect causes epilepsy; strabismus (1/2) does not establish direct ocular damage; neonatal respiratory distress alone does not establish lung damage.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus in 1/2 establishes misalignment, but does not demonstrate direct ocular damage distinct from the neurologic disorder.

basis: B-cell developmental arrest with absent circulating B cells defines an immune and blood-cell disorder; recurrent otitis, pneumonia and meningitis are separate infections.

decisions.haematologic: primary: absent circulating B cells reflect a defining blood-cell developmental defect, meeting the explicit blood-cell disease rule.

basis: Brain anomalies, seizures and developmental impairment define disease; hearing impairment in 2/2 and retinopathy in 1/1 assessed support involvement, with small denominators.

decisions.ocular: involved: retinopathy demonstrates direct retinal pathology; supplied frequency is 1/1 assessed, supporting inclusion despite sparse evidence.

basis: Cerebellar degeneration, neuropathy and vestibular failure define CANVAS; optic atrophy is annotated at 30-79%. Neurogenic weakness/contractures do not establish direct musculoskeletal disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: contractures are annotated at 30-79%, but the record does not establish direct joint or muscle pathology beyond consequences of neuropathy.

basis: The definition includes skeletal/joint dysplasia, fragile skin and ocular disease with myopia/keratoconus; blue sclera alone is non-damaging; vascular complications are rare.

decisions.ocular: primary: myopia and keratoconus are explicitly included among the syndrome's defining manifestations, independently of non-damaging blue sclera.

basis: Hand anomalies establish musculoskeletal involvement; the sparse record and progeroid ancestry do not establish skin dysfunction or other organ damage.

decisions.dermatologic: none: progeroid facial appearance alone does not establish skin or subcutaneous pathology; no specific dermatologic abnormality is supplied.

basis: Retinal dysfunction and skeletal abnormalities define disease; cognitive impairment is annotated at 30-79%. Caries is a separate disease; palate morphology alone does not establish damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: caries (80-99%) is separately diagnosed dental disease; abnormal palate morphology without demonstrated dysfunction does not establish direct damage.

basis: Autoimmune CNS demyelination defines the group; damaging optic neuritis occurs in roughly 50% over the course of multiple sclerosis, the predominant subtype.

decisions.ocular: involved: optic nerve demyelination directly impairs vision; optic neuritis affects roughly 50% over the course of MS, the predominant disease in this umbrella.

basis: Acanthamoeba infection is defined by its pathogen; keratitis causes direct corneal damage and represents most symptomatic cases (>50%); encephalitis is much rarer.

decisions.ocular: involved: keratitis accounts for most symptomatic Acanthamoeba infections (>50%); it is a direct manifestation of infection, not a separate disease merely predisposed to.

basis: Cerebral capillary malformations define a neurovascular disorder; scoliosis (30-79%) lacks evidence of direct skeletal pathology; ocular and skin vascular lesions occur in 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: scoliosis is annotated at 30-79%, but direct skeletal involvement by the vascular disorder is not established; neurologic sequelae alone do not qualify.
